messages:
maya: heads up — quick sync tomorrow to finalize the routing editor UX v-next. main bets: compact playback, clearer reordering affordances, and more actionable validation copy.

chris: compact playback = inline carousel under the rule list, right? keeps the editor context. i can prototype that. :+1:

sam: inline works. propose "ghosting" non-matches instead of full streaming. cheaper and communicates intent.

aleks: agree on ghosting. also want a visible marker (icon + border) for the matched rule so color isn't the only cue.

leo: a11y: ensure the matched marker has role="status" or a live region readout. also make move controls keyboard reachable and 44px target min.

zara: mobile concern: drag handles disappear without hover. fallback = three-dot menu with Move Up / Move Down / Pin to top. pin helps debugging sims.

maya: only allow one pinned rule per policy to avoid clutter. show a tooltip: "Pinned rules stay at top during simulation".

chris: reordering UI idea: both drag handles and explicit up/down buttons. when dragging, show a placeholder and announce "Moving rule to position 2" via aria-live.

sam: implementation: keyboard drag pattern (space to pick up, arrows to move, space to drop) + quick actions (top/bottom). I'll add these to the spike.

aleks: validation copy: current toast says "Invalid" which is too terse. proposals: 
- short: "Needs condition"
- actionable: "Rule inactive — add a match condition to enable."
- technical: "missing_match_condition" (for devs/logging)
We should display the actionable copy in the UI and keep the technical code in telemetry.

leo: include a "Learn how to write conditions" link inside the validation bubble for screen reader users too. aria-label should include link text.

maya: simulation timeline thought: tiny ticks for each rule; click a tick to jump. show tooltip "Rule 3: matched (12ms)". also allow left/right arrows to step.

chris: i'll add a Figma screen with the carousel + tick timeline and both drag + up/down states. will annotate keyboard flows.

sam: i'll draft Cypress + axe checks for keyboard reorder and live region announcements. spike estimate: 2 dev days.

azeks: (typo) meant to say i'll also cover focus ring contrast in tests.

maya: decision list for review: 1) inline compact playback with ghosting + tick timeline; 2) dual reorder controls (drag + up/down + keyboard); 3) actionable validation copy + help link; 4) mobile menu fallback and single-pin rule; 5) accessible live-region announcements and 44px targets. any objections?

chris: none from me. will post Figma link before meeting.

aleks: none. will upload sketches.

leo: no objections. will add a11y acceptance checks to the doc.

maya: great — meeting 2026-04-07 17:30 UTC. i'll share agenda + acceptance criteria in the thread.
